  base64 credentials; the requirement doesn't specify a hashing algorithm, but this is the
  mechanism it describes)
- **Area 11 (SPML connector)** → `REQ-SDP-RSC 9`, `10`, `10.2`
- **Area 12 (Tracing/logging)** → `REQ-SDP-LOG 1`, `3` (transaction-ID logging fix directly
  supports these), `REQ-SDP-LOG 4` (generic log config, thematically via legacy `bf907ec`)
- **Area 3 (Keycloak login)** → no direct requirement match; **in tension** with `REQ-SDP-RPT 1`'s
  NOTE that reporting-UI user management is out of scope (single DB-seeded account) — see Open
  Questions
- **Areas 2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 13, 14** (distributed locking, actuator exposure, platform upgrade,
  MariaDB engine upgrade, new Liquibase changeset, scheduler/pool tuning, SSL) → no matching
  requirement/CR found in `requirements.md`; these are 2025–2026-era infrastructure/platform work
  postdating the 2022 SRS baseline (consistent with `requirements.md`'s own "Undocumented
  Changes" section, which lists 20 such items)

## Known Fragile Areas - Not In Scope This Release
This release's pipeline has no prior runs (`runs/` contains only this `2026-08-31` folder, no
`bugs/` subfolder yet), so the "historical bug frequency from `output/runs/*/bugs/`" portion of
the defect-prone-zone heuristic has **zero data points available this cycle** — that sub-signal
is inconclusive by definition (0 < the ~5-bug guardrail threshold) and was not used. The
following entries rely on `git log --stat` churn counts only, over the original 2022-06-24 to
2023-02-17 build-out window (~8 months, 360 commits — not a short window, so churn counts are
treated as a reliable signal, not inconclusive), cross-referenced against `changes.md`'s legacy
consolidated bug-fix theme (commits tracked against internal Bug IDs 46025–46560). None of the
files below were touched by any change in this release's `changes.md` (2025–2026 era):

- **`RouteConfiguration.kt` (`rsc-service-api`, HTTP route definitions)** — 24 touches in the
  legacy churn window, the single highest-churn source file found. Zero changes this release.
  Not tested this cycle.
- **`rsc-data-loader` report-generation internals (`ReportGeneratorService.kt` — 17 touches,
  `ReportGeneratorRepository.kt` — 13 touches)** — legacy bug theme explicitly includes
  "TPS/error-summary report calculation errors." Zero changes this release (only locking and
  tracing config were touched in `rsc-data-loader` this cycle). Not tested this cycle.
- **SNMP alarm/trap subsystem (`CommonSNMPManager`, both API and data-loader modules)** — legacy
  bug theme includes "SNMP trap message/key corrections" plus a dedicated legacy refinement
  batch (`cbd9414`, `b68fa1b`). Zero changes in the 2025–2026 era. Not tested this cycle.
- **`rsc-data-loader` log-ingestion pipeline (`ServiceStarter.kt` — 12 touches,
  `LoadInFileProcessor`/`TransLogProcessor`)** — legacy bug theme includes "data-loader
  multi-node log-processing and log-rotation issues." Zero changes this release. Not tested this
  cycle.
- **Base Liquibase schema definitions for the three pre-existing schemas** (excluding the new
  `V1_4__rsc_cache_table.sql` changeset, which *is* in scope as Area 10) — legacy bug theme
  includes "DB migration/Liquibase script errors." Zero changes to the base schemas this release.
  Not tested this cycle.

## Out of Scope
- **Redis-based caching/locking (git tag `2.0.1`)** — `changes.md` confirms this is not an
  ancestor of current `HEAD`/`2.0.5`; no `redis` references remain in the shipped source or
  `data/` folder. Excluded pending confirmation via Open Questions that no environment currently
  runs the `2.0.1` build.
- **Multi-SIM handling logic (`REQ-SDP-RSC 14`–`14.6`)** — `requirements.md` found no commit
  specifically touching multi-SIM member-check logic this release; no corresponding change in
  `changes.md`.
- **External Integrations & Deployment topology (`REQ-SDP-EXT 1`–`12`, §4 of the SRS)** — all
  15 items unmatched to any change per `requirements.md` (Active/Active HA, GW failover,
  DB replication topology); this is infra/topology, not application code, and no infra-topology
  change appears in `changes.md`.
- **Data Retention Strategy (`REQ-SDP-DAR 1`–`7`, §7.3 of the SRS)** — all 7 items unmatched to
  any change per `requirements.md`; no retention-policy code found in `changes.md`.
- **SSH password policy (`REQ-SDP-NFR 4`)** — OS/infra-level policy, no corresponding
  application change.
- **SNMP trap scenario coverage (`REQ-SDP-SNM 1`–`3`)** — see Known Fragile Areas above; zero
  code touched this release, so full scenario testing is not warranted this cycle beyond
  confirming the app still starts/stops cleanly (already covered incidentally by Area 8's
  regression pass).

## Test Environment & Data Needs
- **Build/runtime**: JDK 21 toolchain, Maven multi-module build (`mvn clean install`).
- **Database**: MariaDB 11.4 instances for all four schemas (`config_db`, `config_db_test`,
  `reporting_db`, `reporting_db_test`) provisioned via the project's `docker-compose-dev-infa.yml`
  / `docker-compose-dev-test-infa.yml`, migrated via `liquibase.sh` /
  `docker-compose-db-migrate-*.yml`. A parallel MariaDB 10.6.8 instance is useful for Area 9's
  upgrade-comparison testing if not already retired.
- **Test data**: seeded users via `data/initial-data/add-user.sql`; MSISDN test fixtures covering
  valid/invalid length, in-range/out-of-range prefixes, neighbouring-country and
  non-neighbouring-country VLR addresses (for Area 1's TTL logic), and multi-SIM member scenarios.
  Log partitioning (`trx_events_log`, `trans_log`, `tps_log`) must be pre-created before any
  data-loader testing (per `context.md`/Readme.md warning) or inserts will fail.
- **SPML/HLR simulation**: `simulators/rsc-service-simulator` (WireMock) for canned SPML/HLR
  scenarios (roaming true/false, unauthorized, bad request, not-acceptable, internal error,
  delayed response) — required for Areas 1, 6, 11 without needing a live telecom GW connection.
- **Keycloak**: a realm matching `rsc-report-viewer`'s dev config (`issuer-uri:
  https://localhost:8081/realms/rsc-report-viewer`) with test users covering different roles, to
  test Area 3's login/session flow and Area 4's now-uncertain role-gating.
- **Multi-instance setup**: at least two running instances each of `rsc-service-api` and
  `rsc-data-loader` to exercise Areas 1 and 2's distributed cache-sync and lock-contention
  behavior.
- **Actuator access tooling**: `curl`/Postman (or equivalent) to probe `/actuator/**` endpoints
  unauthenticated for Area 5's security testing.
- **Tracing backend**: Zipkin (or log inspection sufficient to confirm trace-ID propagation) for
  Area 12.

## Entry Criteria
- A stable, deployable build for this release (tag `2.0.5` or an equivalent test build) is
  available.
- Test environment is provisioned per Test Environment & Data Needs above: all four MariaDB 11.4
  schemas migrated, Keycloak realm configured, WireMock SPML simulator running, log partitions
  pre-created.
- This test plan has been reviewed and signed off by QA lead and relevant stakeholders.
- The two code-scan Blocker findings (unauthenticated Actuator exposure on both modules, Area 5)
  have been triaged by the release owner — either scheduled for a fix before this cycle or
  explicitly risk-accepted for this test environment.
- High-risk Open Questions below (particularly the `REQ-SDP-RSC 10.1` contract conflict and the
  reporting role-gating removal) have been reviewed with Product/Dev, or an explicit decision has
  been made to proceed without answers and treat the current shipped behavior as intended for
  this cycle.

## Exit Criteria
- All High-risk impacted areas (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) have completed functional, integration,
  regression, negative, and (where applicable) security testing with zero open Blocker/Critical
  defects.
- All Medium and Medium-High risk areas (8, 9, 10, 11, 12) have completed their defined test
  scope with zero open Critical defects; Low/Low-Medium risk areas (13, 14) have received at
  least smoke-level verification.
- The unauthenticated Actuator exposure (Area 5) and unsalted MD5 password hashing (Area 7)
  findings are either remediated and retested, or explicitly risk-accepted in writing by the
  release owner.
- No regressions detected in previously-stable functionality exercised during this cycle (SPML
  roaming lookups, all four reporting screens/exports, distributed cache/lock behavior across
  multiple instances).
- Defect backlog reviewed: no open Blocker, Critical, or High-severity defect remains unresolved
  or unwaived.
- Open Questions below are either answered by Product/Dev and reflected in updated test cases, or
  explicitly deferred with a named owner and target date.
- A test summary report is produced and circulated to QA lead and stakeholders for sign-off.

| When the TPS report's broken download link was fixed, was the underlying page-routing already correct before that fix (meaning only that one page's link text was wrong), or could other report pages still be pointing at the old, broken link path somewhere not yet found? | `changes.md`'s Unclear section on commit `599ce75`: not confirmed from the commit alone whether the route mapping was already correct or whether other templates still reference the old path. | Undocumented Code Behavior (own impact analysis) | Area 4 |
